boxes.question: Is the response written as a project proposal addressed to the employee’s boss, requesting permission to leave work on time?
Does the proposal center on the theme “A Proposal for the Optimization of a Personal Sustainable Dynamic Empowerment Model,” or a clearly equivalent formulation?
Does the employee speak as an ordinary worker whose thinking or language is comically alienated by internet jargon?
Does the response avoid directly saying that the employee is tired and wants to go home?
Does it frame leaving work on time as a strategic decision that creates long-term value for the company?
Does it use jargon heavily, including several of the specified terms such as “user experience,” “cost reduction,” “touchpoint,” “ecosystem,” and “to give back”?
Is the proposal coherent and effective as a piece of writing, rather than merely listing jargon or repeating the instructions?
